title: 2 BOXES OF VARIOUS GLASS STEM ...
reason: Mixed Art Deco era glass with 4 iridescent gilt-rimmed Bohemian style coupes, a pressed leaf tray and a frosted-stopper scent bottle; unmarked, so value stays modest unless a maker turns up.
findings: Under-described: two boxes laid out as about 30 pieces of mostly 1930s style glass on black cloth. Seen: 4 iridescent lustre coupes with lobed quatrefoil bowls, fine gilt rims and gilt-edged feet (Bohemian style, unmarked); a large round pressed glass leaf-pattern tray with frosted side handles (Art Deco style); a tall waisted clear vase; a cut glass scent bottle with a frosted flower stopper (Lalique style, but nothing shows it is Lalique); a domed moulded scroll-pattern scent bottle (stopper not seen) and a flower-shaped pressed trinket dish; engraved grape vine flutes, a star-cut coupe, an Art Deco geometric etched coupe, a cut crystal wine glass and 2 banded champagne coupes; a cobalt blue vase and 2 gilt cobalt beakers; a small gilt cordial glass; a faceted dish, an egg paperweight and a small frosted figure on a clear block; 2 large plain bowls. No maker marks, signatures, acid stamps or labels are visible and bases are not shown, so no maker is supported.
condition: No obvious chips or cracks at photo size, but rims, stems and feet are not shown closely. The gilt on the coupes looks thin and rubbed in places. The frosted flower stopper bottle has its stopper; the domed scent bottle shows none.
rescore_note: About 30 pieces of unmarked 1930s era glass; best are 4 iridescent gilt-rimmed Bohemian style coupes and a pressed Deco leaf tray, but no maker is supported (the frosted-stopper scent bottle is Lalique style only) and the rest is ordinary stemware; $30-80 band. No comp seen.
